old_suite.rule: Unmodified original Z/T/S/X/W evaluator and complete denominators; no seed substitution.

geometry.definition: Distance from actual sensor origin to finite floor/x-wall/y-wall rectangles, including initial state and all subsequent observations.
geometry.reset: Solve root position from rotated sensor offset to achieve specified sensor distance, verify actual reset state; never use body-centre distance as sensor distance.
geometry.reset_velocity: Initial root linear/angular velocity zero; audit actual reset against generated specification. Speed factor in these blocks varies command magnitude, not initial velocity.

lane_stratification.center: 8 world horizontal directions, four lanes each; lane j direction j%8. Yaw stratum (j//8+j%8)%5. Independent bounded xy offsets per lane. Commands converted world-to-body using current orientation at each control boundary.
lane_stratification.wall: lanes 0..15 x wall,16..31 y wall; within each wall four lanes per toward/away/parallel/zero mode; parallel signs balanced. Yaw and tangent vary. Report wall × mode separately.
lane_stratification.pulse: 8 world force directions with four lanes each; zero commanded velocity throughout.
lane_stratification.command_execution: Stage next world command before env.step. At actual next observation boundary, rotate with measured current attitude before history.update; both internal/external latest command and retained past command frames stay consistent. No world pose/attitude fields are appended to actor.

measurement_chain.noise: Independent additive normal draws clipped to +/-3 sigma, applied to finite valid ranges only; clip physical ranges to declared sensor min/max; preserve invalid validity. Zero noise consumes no noise draws. For nonzero sigma, draw every beam on every acquisition from the condition/lane stream independently of validity; mask only application. Different validity masks cannot shift shared-beam or subsequent-acquisition draws.
measurement_chain.delivery: A single impaired measurement frame feeds both actor and ICS, including consistent validity and acquisition/delivery timestamps. Clean measurement is audit/evaluation only.
measurement_chain.delay_initialization: No prior frame: invalid unavailable sample, not a synthetic fresh frame; preserve this transient. Placeholder timestamp0 is marked frame_available=false and all beam validity=false; it is not a received frame.
measurement_chain.drop: At specified policy steps, no new frame; retain prior frame with original acquisition timestamp and increment age; dropped-delivery flag true. No fabricated new timestamp.
measurement_chain.invalid_fill: Every invalid beam preserves exact40.0m fill; reject other invalid representations before actor history.
measurement_chain.drop_index_semantics: Observation boundary index k at block time k*0.1s, including reset boundary0; frame k feeds action k. drop_policy_steps70/180 therefore drop delivery at t7.0/t18.0s, not post-action70/180.

noise_replay_algorithm.delivery_device: Transfer noised ranges to runtime device after CPU addition and clipping
noise_replay_algorithm.verification: Bit-exact CPU replay from archived clean ranges, validity, delivery time and audit reset masks; real GPU transfer and timing remain unverified
noise_replay_algorithm.change_status: New prelive candidate; previous device-dependent stream identities remain historical. Capacity and independent review pending.

pulse.force_formula: force_N = registered acceleration * verified runtime mass; world horizontal force at COM, no extra torque, in addition to rotor forces.
pulse.verification: Record applied force every physics tick and actual mass. No direct velocity overwrite. Confirm force composition does not erase rotor wrench.
pulse.recovery_clock: Starts at removal of final force tick (t=5.2s), not at pulse onset.

runtime_staging.distribution: F_body_world = measured_body_mass * registered_acceleration_world, transform each by actual body link orientation, add to fresh rotor forces; preserve rotor torques
runtime_staging.time: zero-based block physics ticks1000..1039; check actual simulator tick increments each call; no reset rewinds block clock
runtime_staging.mass: Caller supplies pinned baseline total mass; every tick measured sum must agree within1e-5kg; no mass mutation
runtime_staging.audit: Every physics tick records dt, simulator/block ticks, dtype, measured per-body mass, actual body-link quaternion, fresh rotor wrench, added world/local forces and staged total local wrench. Result records completed simulator tick after last stage. Staging/clock records are not independent physical integration proof.

metrics.all: Every lane retains all initial transients, collisions, height failures, reset interruptions and missing required audit records. Missing record fails; intentional measured dropout with complete audit is not missing evidence. All numerics finite.

stop.command: 100 steps constant world-direction speed then 230 steps zero.
stop.motion_prerequisite: Projection along commanded direction >= speed/2 for 11 consecutive observations before stop.
stop.stop_confirmation: 3D speed <= .08 for 11 consecutive samples, confirmation within 3s of zero command PRE_STEP boundary.
stop.hold: 201 observations starting at confirmation, speed RMS <= .08, max horizontal displacement from confirmation position <= .30m; global height constraint still applies.

reverse.rules: Original X numeric thresholds: error <=.10 for 11 samples confirmed within3s of each switch; nonzero RMSE<=.15/stable<=.10; zero RMS<=.08/drift<=.30; projected peak<=1.5*speed. Add signed motion>=speed/2 for11 samples in each nonzero block.

pulse_hold.recovery: 11 consecutive samples speed<=.08 confirmed within3s after force removal; hold201 observations from confirmation with RMS<=.08/drift<=.30. Reference is post-recovery confirmation, not old position; no H2 claim.

wall_modes.toward: Require actual world wall-normal speed>=speed/2 for11 consecutive observations before the first qualifying sample of stopping confirmation. First geometric clearance<=1.1m triggers 3s stop confirmation; otherwise proactive confirmation within20s from start. After confirmation speed RMS<=.08 with at least101 observations, all-time distance>=.8 and height gate.
wall_modes.away_parallel: 100 steps assigned direction then230 zero, stop rules; geometry still all-time. Parallel signs balanced.
wall_modes.zero: Original Z metrics over entire330 steps, all-time geometry/height.

aggregation.target: Every target block must have32/32 successful lanes; every direction and wall×mode subgroup must have all its lanes pass. Each final seed passes separately. No averaging away failed seeds.
aggregation.stress: Same lane rules and full denominators, report failure boundary; not required for target PASS.
aggregation.confidence: Wilson two-sided95% per block/subgroup and per seed, report n; no iid or universal safety claim from correlated lanes or3seeds.
aggregation.learning: Paired common realization comparison to frozen u640; controller changes need fixed-policy control before RL attribution.

open_before_freeze: Implement new scorer and CPU counterexamples; never route new traces through old initial-state/seed checks.
Prove sensor timing/force/reset implementation and CPU random stream separation.
Independent physical feasibility review, especially low-speed movement prerequisites and nearwall stopping.
Exact output/time/init/reset/optimizer accounting and pipeline rehearsal.

metric_implementation.scope: Motion and finite-rectangle geometry only; motion_pass requires separate input-chain/force/reset/RNG provenance acceptance before scientific PASS.

reset_execution.root_pose: reset_spec for every lane, sensor-relative target corrected by rotated mount; write pose and zero velocities after base history/rotor reset
reset_execution.verification: After actual sensor refresh, compare public root state and composed actual sensor parent/mount pose against spec; persist mismatches before rejection
reset_execution.position_tolerance_reason: Float32 world-origin addition/subtraction precision; does not round observations or alter0.8m geometric scoring
reset_execution.automatic_resets: Reapply same registered per-lane reset pose; do not rewind block physics clock or measurement random stream. Record actual reset and mark metric reset failures.

physics_replay.numeric_tolerance: 16*dtype_epsilon*max(1,max(abs(expected))) for wrench arithmetic; exact unchanged torque and inactive rotor wrench
physics_replay.reset_tolerance: Recompute max(1e-5,2*dtype_epsilon*max(1,abs(actual_world_coordinates))); check archived world-to-local subtraction and seeded reset_spec
